rows.hypothesis: Order-flow footprint signals (4 tested; 2 data-blocked, disclosed)
rows.verdict_detail: pre-registered outcome (a) informational null for H1 and H2 (fail BH-FDR); outcome (c) underpowered for H3 and H6 (62 and 286 in-sample events, below the 300-event gate); H4 and H5 data-blocked, untested
rows.mechanism: best cell ~2 bp gross vs 18 bp materiality bar (1.5× ~12 bp round-trip cost); no OOS return statistic computed or reported

stats.label: BH-FDR significant cells (q = 0.10)
stats.locator: column p_value (20 rows) through orderflow.stats.bh_fdr at q = 0.10; column bh_significant_q10 is false in all 20 rows

stats.label: smallest BH-adjusted q
stats.locator: column p_value: min over rank i of p_(i) * 20 / i, attained at rank 2 (signal H1, horizon_bars 12, p 0.01092) and shared by H1 horizon_bars 6 after the step-up

stats.label: best cell gross mean (H1, 1h)
stats.locator: row signal H1, horizon_bars 12, column observed_mean_bp (highest mean among cells with raw p < 0.05, as runners/phase5_final_report.py defines best cell)

stats.label: H3 in-sample events
stats.locator: rows signal H3, column n_events (max over horizons, as gate 1 uses)

stats.label: H6 in-sample events
stats.locator: rows signal H6, column n_events (max over horizons, as gate 1 uses)

caveats: At the pre-registered 10,000 reps the outcome depended on the seed: before commit e4a5d09 fixed it, one unseeded run passed H1's BH-FDR gate (at least two H1 cells under the BH threshold); H1's means still failed the 18 bp materiality gate. The committed runs at 10,000 and 2,000,000 reps are 0/20 (preregistration/DEVIATIONS.md entry 3).
Bootstrap reps were raised from the pre-registered 10,000 to 2,000,000 after sign-off (preregistration/DEVIATIONS.md entry 1).
The bootstrap draws event-days iid with replacement (a day-cluster bootstrap), not a stationary block bootstrap.
Best cell = highest mean among cells with raw p < 0.05; the highest raw mean is H3 h=48 at 16.0 bp (N = 62, p = 0.34).

OOS bars were read for event detection and event counts, and the run behind the committed cells computed per-event OOS forward returns in memory before filtering to in-sample; none entered any statistic.
H4 and H5 are data-blocked (no full-depth L2 history) and untested; no claim is made for them.
